_comment: Machine-readable form of the non-negotiable rules. scripts/compliance_gate.py loads this file and refuses any request that violates it. Editing this file is a policy change: log it in audit/CHANGELOG.md with a reason.

non_negotiable.rule: Every video is labeled 'Made for Kids' in YouTube Studio. No exceptions.
No personalized ads, comments, notifications, or live chat on any video.
non_negotiable.authority: 16 C.F.R. 312.2 (definition of 'collects'); YouTube MFK feature restrictions

non_negotiable.rule: No mass-production patterns. No near-duplicate uploads, no template farms. High volume is permitted; near-duplication at any volume is not.
non_negotiable.authority: YouTube policy on repetitious / mass-produced content
non_negotiable.notes: Cadence raised to 2 long + 2 shorts per day on 2026-09-03 by the channel owner. The cap moved; the duplication rule did not. Enforcement shifted from a volume ceiling to a per-title cooldown plus treatment-difference scoring.

non_negotiable.rule: All AI output is human-reviewed for warped faces, extra limbs, garbled text, and unsafe or creepy visuals.
Music is public-domain rhymes only, or properly licensed. No famous recorded versions.
No collecting personal data from children anywhere off-platform.
Photorealistic AI content carries the required altered/synthetic-content label. Cartoon-style does not, but still gets the kids setting.

agent_operating_rules: Read every file in compliance/ before generating any content.
Refuse any request that violates a rule in compliance/.
Run every script and video prompt through the review/ checklist before it leaves the agent.
Log every decision in audit/decision_log.csv with date and reason.
Flag anything uncertain instead of guessing.
Never auto-publish. A named human passes the review/ gate first.
Never schedule a publish slot that has not passed the human review gate. Bulk scheduling stacks APPROVED items into future dates; it never front-runs review.

banned_in_copy._comment: Substrings that must never appear in a title, description, thumbnail, or on-screen text. Case-insensitive. Enforced by scripts/compliance_gate.py.

protected_brands_and_characters._comment: Never generate, name, or visually imitate these. Not exhaustive; when unsure, FLAG.

thresholds._threshold_rationale: Calibrated against how many of the three treatment dimensions (setting, palette, companion) two videos share: 0 shared ~0.28, 1 shared ~0.45, 2 shared ~0.74, 3 shared ~1.00. Block at 0.70 means two of three identical is a reskin and is refused. Flag at 0.60 catches the approach to that. Sharing ONE dimension with something three weeks old is normal at four uploads a day and passes silently - the earlier 0.40/0.55 pair was set for 3 videos/week and flagged 96% of a daily calendar, which trains reviewers to click through every warning.

cadence._comment: Publishing cadence. Changing this is a policy decision: log it in audit/CHANGELOG.md.
